profile.headline: Web Developer at Moji Apps
profile.summary: I have a diverse set of skills ranging from graphic design to web development. I have built eCommerce, brochure websites and Single Page Applications utilizing a myriad of frameworks and tools including WordPress, Javascript, PHP & AngularJS.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Developed S.P.A. applications utilizing Angular JS.
• Built Angular Reggae S.P.A. - Integrated Youtube API into Angular Reggae Spa.
• Environments: AngularJS, jQuery, WordPress, Twitter Bootstrap, Javascript, JQuery.

positions.title: Jr Front End Developer
positions.description:
• Designed mockups and wireframes for client websites utilizing AI & PSD.
• Converted wireframes and mockups into pixel perfect WordPress websites.
• Built several eCommerce websites utilizing WooCommerce.
• Created many rich, highly interactive responsive web sites and UI components with Jquery, HTML5, and CSS3.

positions.title: Web Designer
positions.description:
• Created responsive web sites and UI components with Jquery, HTML5, and CSS3.
• Design and Deploy clean standards w3c compliant HTML5 websites.
• Meet with client every week with a progress report
• Maximize front-end experiences using JavaScript, jQuery and SASS.
• Implement responsive web interfaces using the Bootstrap framework. 
• Version control system of use Git.
• Develop website mock-ups for client satisfaction before project development phase.

positions.title: Wire Technician
positions.description:
• Installing Vdsl,Voip and Video to residence and business.
•  Verify all services are working correctly, via wiring jumpers at cross boxes , changing aerial wire at terminal on pole, installing or using Network Interface Device(NID) on side of residence to get service inside residence.
• Category 5 wire homerun terminating in a rg45 jack connected via ethernet cord to the residential gateway.
• Educate customers on service features and functionality. 
• Repair any problems current customers face. No signal to residence, No video , slow internet  speed, intermittent service.
• worked in small confined spaces or a loft(climb poles), work with hand tools, worked outdoors in all kinds of weather.

positions.title: Senior Digital Designer
positions.description:
• Create wedding material: Wedding Invitations, Save the Date, Wedding Programs.
• Meet with wedding coordinator weekly.
• Implement design concepts based on wedding themes.
• Design, revise & update web-based materials including publications, posters, brochures.
• Create mock-ups, wireframes, website layout and custom graphics for websites.
• Digital photo development & editing

positions.title: Print Specialist
positions.description:
Produce complex print orders and operate equipment that require advanced technical knowledge and expertise.
Skills: Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Acrobat, Adobe InDesign, Microsoft Office Excel, Microsoft Office Powerpoint, Microsoft Word

positions.title: Graphic/Web Designer
positions.description:
• Provide customer service, including anticipating customer needs, suggesting alternatives.
• Small and large format printing  from  letter size to poster size. 
• Produce  finishing  for small and large formats  with mounting, lamination, cuts.
• Operate the Point of Sale terminal (POS), handling cash transactions.

volunteerExperiences.role: Organizing a program for feeding the homeless
